content: Hikɨ Yawé Nuhexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «'Ekɨ xeikɨa 'aixɨa pekatiniuka'iyarini 'ena pemuyeika, kanuwa 'amɨtimariwetsie keneutahaki 'atɨɨriyama xeyunaitɨ.
Yunaime tewaxi mawariyari memɨnaki'eriwa, keniwareuta'ɨna me'atahutame 'ukitsi meta 'ukari, yeutari 'aixɨa memɨka'anene mawariyari yuxexuime 'ukitsi meta 'ukari.
Memɨte'awɨwaweta yunaime me'atahutame, 'ukitsi meta 'ukari, memɨkaheuyewautsenikɨ 'ena kwiepa.
Karikɨ 'atahutarieka tukari 'aye'ayu, wiyeri nekaniyuitɨamɨkɨ 'ena kwiepa mɨkawiyekɨ huta tewiyari tukari meta tɨkarikɨ, mɨpaɨ nekatiniwarakumaweriyamɨkɨ kwiepa memɨtama nemɨwarutawewi».
Nuhexi naime yakatiniuyurieni Yawé kemɨtita'aitɨa.
'Ataxewime tsienituyari wiyari pexeiyakai Nuhexi, kepauka mɨtiutihauritɨxɨ.
Hikɨ kaneutahani kanuwa 'amɨtimariwetsie niwemama yunaitɨ, 'ɨyaya meta mu'e'emama, meyutawikweitsitɨanike mɨtitihauritɨkekaikɨ.
Yunaitɨ tewatsiekate memɨmawarɨwa meta memɨkamawarɨwa yeutari, memɨte'awɨwawe meta kuterixi,
mekaneutahaxɨani Nuhexi hamatɨa yuhuhutatɨ meheuyuti'iwatɨkaitɨ 'uki 'uka, Kakaɨyari kemɨra'aitakai.
'Atahutarieka tukari 'anukayaku, wiyeri kanitsutɨani kwiepa memɨtihaunitsie mieme.
Kepauka Nuhexi 'ataxewime tsienituyari wiyari mexeiyakai, hutarieka metseriyaritsie tamamata heimana 'atahuta tukariyaritsie, 'ana haramaratsie haa patinexɨa, muyuawitsie pɨreuyepierixɨa mɨkawiyekɨ.
Huta tewiyari tukari meta tɨkari kaniwiyekaitɨni kwiepa.
Mɨkɨ tukaritsie Nuhexi kanuwatsie mekaneutahaxɨani, niwemama Tsemi, Kami meta Kapeti, Nuhexi 'ɨyaya meta mu'e'emama yuhaikatɨ.
Wahamatɨa mekaneutahaxɨani yunaitɨ yeutari meta tewaxi, kuterixi metatsiere memɨte'awɨwawe.
Mɨpaɨ mekateneutahaxɨani kanuwa 'amɨtimariwetsie Nuhexi hamatɨa yunaitɨ meheuyuti'iwatɨkaitɨ kwiepa memɨtexuawe,
yunaitɨ memɨtexuawe yɨkɨ mete'anenetɨ, mekaneutahaxɨani meheuyutinɨtɨ 'uki 'uka, Kakaɨyari Nuhexi kemɨra'aitɨwakai. Hikɨ Yawé 'ana katineunani kitenie kanuwatsie.
Hikɨ karima kaniwiyekaitɨni huta tewiyari tukari. Kepauka haa muwayenexɨa kanuwa 'amɨtimariwe kananuyewiere kwie heima.
Hikɨ matsi haa waɨkawa kanewayenetɨkateitɨni haa kanitimiekaitɨni, kanuwata kananuyewiekaitɨni hetsiena.
Waɨkawa haa kanitiyani hɨri 'amanutitɨtɨ kwiepa meutitekai naime kaneuyunitɨaxɨani.
Hɨri heima 'atahuta meturuyari kuxi haa kanitiyani.
Mɨpaɨ mekateneuyehɨiyani kwiepa memɨte'u'uwakai: memɨte'awɨwawe, yeutari, tewaxi, kuterixi, metatsiere teɨteri.
Yunaitɨ mekateniukwini kwiepa memɨte'u'uwakai, yunaitɨ memɨte'ayeyuyurikai.

Kakaɨyari kwiepa katiniwarakuyeitɨani yunaime memɨte'u'uwakai, teɨteri meta tewaxi meta yeutari, kuterixi, meta memɨte'awɨwawe meteyunaime. Yunaitɨ mekatenakuyeituarieni kwiepa memu'uwakai. Nuhexi xeikɨa mekaniuyuhayewa meta kemɨ'ane hamatɨana memɨyetekai kanuwa 'amɨtimariwetsie.
Xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata tukari kwie kaneuyunekaitɨni.
